exposure: 10 groups based on parity, previous cesarean section, gestational age, onset of labor, fetal presentation, and number of fetuses
cohort: 1787 pregnant women who underwent cesarean delivery
finding: The most common causes of cesarean delivery were previous cesarean delivery and fetal distress, highlighting the need to motivate women with a history of cesarean delivery to consider vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC).
